candidate.definition_en: With opposite sides or surfaces that are a great distance apart; not thin.
candidate.explanation_ar: تخين أو سميك.. عكس رفيع. ممكن توصف كتاب، حيطة، أو حتى سائل تقيل.

senses.definition_en: Having a large distance between opposite surfaces; not thin.
examples: The walls are thick to keep the house warm.

senses.definition_en: Growing or existing closely together; dense.
examples: The fog was so thick we couldn't see.
The walls are thick to keep the house warm.
The fog was so thick we couldn't see.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Thick' قريبة من 'Stick' 'عصاية'.. العصاية ممكن تكون 'Thick'.
